title: The Shark Diaries
summary: A special Shark Week episode presented as an audio radio play, "The Shark Diaries," dramatizing the 1916 shark attacks along the New Jersey Shore (Beach Haven, Spring Lake, Matawan Creek) through fictional diary entries voiced by cast members. Josh and Chuck introduce the backstory (the attacks that inspired Jaws), the characters based on real figures such as ichthyologist John C. Nichols, his mentor Frederick Lucas, Charles Van Zandt, Charles Bruder, Stanley Fisher, Lester Stillwell, and survivor Joseph Dunn, then perform the play and close with credits and contact information.

segments.title: Opening and backstory of the 1916 shark attacks
segments.summary: Josh and Chuck introduce the special Shark Week radio play and explain the 1916 Jersey Shore and Matawan Creek shark attacks, which inspired Peter Benchley's Jaws.

segments.title: Introducing the characters and cast
segments.summary: The hosts describe the real-life figures the play portrays, including Nichols, Lucas, Louise Van Zandt, Stanley Fisher, Mary Anderson, and survivor Joseph Dunn, and who voices each role.

segments.title: The Shark Diaries radio play
segments.summary: Dramatized diary entries from July 1916 to October 1916 covering the Beach Haven and Spring Lake attacks, the Matawan Creek attack that killed Lester Stillwell and Stanley Fisher, the hunt for the shark, the hospitalization of a young victim, and Nichols's closing reflections.

segments.title: Closing credits and contact information
segments.summary: The hosts praise the cast and crew, then give contact information for the show via Twitter, Facebook, and email, and point listeners to HowStuffWorks.com.
